text:
alex_chang: Heads up — docs-link-scan just flagged a cluster of 404 anchors in /docs/runtime/quickstart. Seeing flaky e2e in canary, not blocking but noisy. Anyone owning runtime/quickstart anchors?

deploy-bot: docs-link-scan: 12 failures found in /docs/runtime/quickstart -> https://internal-scan.redwood.ai/reports/1712319999 (auto-report)

nina_docs: @alex_chang I can take this. Which anchors are failing? can you paste the failing URLs/snippets?

alex_chang: Thanks @nina_docs — snippet from report:
```
/docs/runtime/quickstart.md#session-management -> 404
/docs/runtime/quickstart.md#kv-cache -> 404
/docs/runtime/quickstart.md#canary-routing -> 404
```
I think these got renamed in the last runtime docs PR but redirects weren't added.

nina_docs: ah, that explains it. I'll open a tiny PR to re-add stable anchors + a redirect mapping. Quick grep I run locally: `rg "^#+ .*session" -n docs | sed -n '1,200p'`

ryan_oncall: I can run the canary smoke after the fix — ping me when the PR is up and I'll queue it (in ~10m). :thumbsup:

sam_engineer: @nina_docs do you want me to bundle the anchor fixes with the runtime sample patch I'm already working on? could avoid two deploys.

nina_docs: prefer a separate tiny PR for easier rollback. I'll open `docs/quickstart-anchor-fix` in a minute and ping for review. @jenni can you do a fast CR?

jenni: on it — will review within 30m. @ryan_oncall please queue canary after merge.

alex_chang: thanks team. I'll add a quick note to the runbook and PR description to run `docs-link-scan --anchors` as part of the docs checklist so this doesn't slip through.
